Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant comeback from the Lankans today to snare the last 8 wickets for 89 runs. They removed Duminy late yesterday and were bang on the money from ball one today. Pradeep and Kumara with 4-fers led the charge while Lakmal was really unlucky not to get a single scalp. Tons from Amla and Duminy formed bulk of the runs while de Kock and Parnell added some handy runs down the order today. On this lively surface, 426 looks a huge score. Tricky phase for the visitors to survive till tea. Stay tuned for the reply.

OUT! Caught! It's a stunner of a catch from Dhananjaya de Silva. Kumara hurls a back of a length ball outside off, de Kock chases it as he looks to slash this one over point. Gets it right but de Silva in the deep comes sprinting across to his left and takes a diving catch at deep point. SOUTH AFRICA BOWLED OUT FOR 426!
Woaah! Chandimal collects one down the leg side. Full and sprayed down the leg side, Kagiso looks to flick but misses and Chandi behind the stumps dives full length to his right to stop it.
Good length angling in from over the wicket, Rabada fails to clip and is hit on the thigh pad.
Slanting it across the batsman, KR doesn't feel for it.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended with a straight blade.
Short of a length outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, it's bunted back to the bowler.
Angles it in from off, Rabada defends it down gently into the ground.
Length ball served wide outside off, KR makes third leave in a row.
Good length delivery on off, moves away after pitching, Rabada makes another leave.
In the channel outside off, KR leaves it alone.
Angles it in from around off, Kagiso plays inside the line and gets beaten.
KAGISO RABADA is the last man in.

OUT! Gone! Straight to the fielder! On a length and outside off, Wayne Parnell looks to hit this one over point. He does so but it goes straight down the throat of Upul Tharanga at deep point. A frustrating stand comes to an end. de Silva was asked to bowl the over but then for some reason Mathews asked Kumara to bowl. He delivers it on the very first ball.
LAHIRU KUMARA is back on. Dhananjaya de Silva was initially given the ball but Mathews changes his mind.
QDK defends it from within the crease.

Edged and dropped! But why is there just a slip in place? Good length delivery outside off, Parnell feels for it and as a result gets a thick outside edge towards slip. Karunaratne at first slip dives full length to his left but the ball doesn't stick in his hands. It bursts through and they take three. Pradeep will have to wait for a 5-fer here.
Angles it full on middle, driven towards mid on.
Short and strangling down the leg side, Parnell sits under it.
Sprays it full on off, de Kock drives it through point for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and gets it to nip back in from around off, de Kock looks to play it across the line but misses and gets hit on abdomen.
Nuwan Pradeep is back into the attack!
Stands tall and thumps it through cover-point to keep strike. A single taken.
Short of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Fuller and fired on the stumps, Wayne digs it out.
Chases the wide delivery outside off and gets beaten again.
Parnell plays inside the line and leaves it alone.
Starts from around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, Quinton works it off his hips to square leg for a single to get off strike.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to bowl.
Touch short and outside off, tapped off the back foot towards covers. They wanted a single but won't get it.
Once again around the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Tickled! Chandimal didn't even move an inch. Mathews sprays it on the pads, de Kock gets across and just tickles it down to fine leg for a boundary. This is turning out to be a huge over from the Lankan skipper.

Angles in a length delivery on the pads, tucked through backward square leg. Dilruwan Perera in the deep comes across to his right and makes a sliding stop to save a run for his side. Three runs added to the total.
FOUR! Shortish and outside off, Wayne Parnell cuts it nicely. Makes a good connection and earns a boundary through cover-point.
Back of a length ball outside off, de Kock pushes it through point for one.
Comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Changes the angle and comes from around the wicket, he hurls it on a length around off, Parnell tries to poke at it but gets beaten. Lakmal, you Lakmal!
Stays put in the crease and defends it away on the off side.
Too full and too wide outside off, the batsman doesn't look at it.
Back of a length ball and wide outside off, it's cut towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock defends it down the wicket.
WP has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length and around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Wooosh! Fuller in length and curling in from outside off, Parnell makes a leave but he can consider himself lucky as the ball almost kisses the off pole before going into the keeper's gloves.
Outside off, the batsman offers no stoke to it.
In the channel outside off, WP lifts his bat to let it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, QDK cuts it past a diving gully fielder for a single.
Short outside off, Wayne looks to slash it over point but the ball bounces a bit more and he fails to get going with the shot.
Fullish in length and around off, driven straight to mid off.
Length ball around off, de Kock looks to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards backward point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Parnell taps it towards the off side.
Angles in outside off, Wayne doesn't play at it.

Beaten! On a length and moves away ever so slightly, Parnell looks to defend it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper. We have seen this happening umpteenth times in the first session.
Good length ball on off, defended with a straight bat.
This one comes in a bit, QDK looks to defend and it goes on the bounce to the man at gully who moves to his right to stop that one.
Good length, angling across, de Kock tries to play the lazy shot and gets beaten completely.
Very full on off, driven on the bounce to the man at mid off.
FOUR! Flayed! Short of a length delivery, with width on offer. Quinton stays put as he slashes it through backward point to find the fence.That raced away in a jiffy.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards covers.
Angelo Mathews will bowl from the other end!
On a length and around off, WP doesn't play at it.
Fuller and hurled wide outside off, Parnell shoulders his arms.
Angles it across, Wayne makes an easy leave to the keeper.
On a length and just outside off, Parnell pushes it towards point from the crease.
On the pads, tucked towards square leg for a single.

What was that from Lakmal? Frustration? Fuller and curling in a bit, de Kock bunts it back to the bowler who collects it with his right hand and throws it back at the striker's end. Luckily Quinton ducks to evade it. Suranga then apologizes for doing so.

We are back for the afternoon session. How long can the South African tail wag with de Kock. Remains to be seen. Sri Lankan would be eyeing to wrap it up rather quickly and then have a go with the willow. It shall be Suranga Lakmal to begin proceedings after lunch...
...DAY 2, SESSION 2...

This session - 24 overs, 60 runs and 5 wickets. Great session for Sri Lanka after the battering yesterday. Their pacers all found the radar and also created constant pressure with Pradeep being the standout with a 4-fer. Lakmal was mighty impressive too but was unlucky not to get more wickets. Amla couldn't add much to his overnight score and wickets kept falling. The pitch has quickened up and there is prodigious movement. 398 seems enough already and de Kock will want to add a few more to the tally. Join us in a short while for the second session to see how things pan out after lunch.
Length ball outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot. LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Good length angled in from around off, stays in the crease and taps it to cover.
Length ball slanted in from around off, blocked well from the crease to cover.
Good length angled across Parnell who lets it pass to the keeper.
Length ball closer to off, Parnell stays in the crease and blocks.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length down the leg side, de Kock misses the flick.
Length ball around off, gets across and defends it down the pitch.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
FOUR! Good shot! He loves the leg side a lot. Fuller on middle and leg, de Kock gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Beaten again! Back of a length outside off, de Kock tries to cut but is beaten by the bounce.
Good ball! Length delivery outside off, de Kock looks to push at it but the sharp inward movement sees the ball whistle past the inside edge.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pats it towards wide mid off.
Fuller outside off, leans across and drives it past mid on for a single.
Fuller on off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
That was very close! Good length angled in from around off, left alone and the ball nips back in sharply to just past the stumps. Chandimal dives to his right but fails to gather it. A bye taken.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Attempted yorker at 139.9 kph, low full toss eventually as de Kock gets an inside edge to the leg side for a sharp single.
FOUR! SHOT! Too full and outside off, Parnell leans forward and drives it sweetly through the vacant extra cover region for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Parnell plays inside the line and is beaten.
FOUR! EDGED....BUT SAFE! Full and angled in from around off, Parnell fishes at it and gets an outside edge. It flies just past third slip to the fence for a boundary. Agonizing moment for Kumara.
Bowled full outside off from around the wicket, left alone to the keeper.
Good length on middle and leg, gets across and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length closer to off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on off, leans across and drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full and on the pads, easy for Parnell who flicks it uppishly over mid-wicket to find the fence. Gets off the mark in good fashion.
Fired down the leg side, Parnell misses the flick.
WAYNE PARNELL walks out to bat.

OUT! WHAT A RIPPER! Absolutely unplayable stuff from Pradeep and Philander has to go. Good length on fourth stump line, kicks up off the deck with extra bounce. Gets the nick through to Chandimal who takes it comfortably. What a spell this has been from Pradeep! He now has four wickets to his name.
Fuller outside off, pushed to cover for a single.
Good length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Philander survives. Shortish on middle and leg, he looks to play across the line as it goes down the leg side to Chandimal. The appeal for caught behind is accepted by the umpire. Philander goes for the review very quickly. Replays show that there is some glove involved but it came off Philander's right glove which wasn't in contact with the bat at that moment as he had taken the hand off the blade. So, the on-field call will be reversed.
Philander has been given out caught behind. He takes the review instantly. There was a noise although it's not clear if he nicked it.
Too straight again from Kumara, clipped down to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Superb shot! Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and flicks it away through mid-wicket. Lovely shot and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. Cannot bowl that line to this man, he'll punish you ruthlessly.
Spears this well wide outside off, so much so that the umpire signals wide.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, de Kock chases it but gets beaten.
Gully moves to fourth slip.
FOUR! EDGE FALLS SAFE! Length ball outside off, de Kock pushes at it but gets the outside edge due to the away movement. Just flies past third slip towards the fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length on off, nips back in sharply to rap the thigh pad.
VERNON PHILANDER walks out to bat.

OUT! Excellent by Chandimal! Good length outside off, shapes away late to force the edge as Amla is squared up. Chandimal dives to his right to take a brilliant one-handed catch. Superb stuff from the keeper as the edge was dying and wouldn't have carried to first slip. Sri Lanka's morning continues to get better and better. Great knock from Amla comes to an end and he receives a warm round of applause.
Good length outside off, shapes away sharply, left alone to the keeper.
Beaten! Excellent bowling this and the SA batsmen are all at the sea currently. Length ball angled away on off, shapes further away to beat de Kock all ends up.
Back of a length on middle, climbs awkwardly on Quinton who rises on his toes to fend.
Length ball outside off, Quinton looks to block but gets the outside edge. The ball rolls towards gully.
Beaten! Full and outside off, shapes away extravagantly as de Kock is beaten on the drive.
Good length slanting across the left-hander, Quinton lets it pass.
Fuller on middle and leg, glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and drives it to mid off.
Good length outside off, de Kock looks to block but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Back of a length on middle, raps de Kock on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards gully.
Fuller outside off, squirted towards point off the outer half.
Good length on middle, tails in, de Kock gets an inside edge on the pad.
Length ball outside off, stays back to cut but gets a bottom edge to cover.

The inswinger goes wrong as it's fired well down the leg side, de Kock misses the flick and Chandimal fails to gather cleanly despite a dive to his right. Not the first time he's struggled to collect down the leg side. A bye taken.
Fuller on off, Amla gets an inside edge on the inswinger down to fine leg for a single.
Sharp inswinger that comes back in sharply to rap Amla on the thigh pad.
Speared well down the leg side, Amla looks to flick but misses.
Full and wider outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller on the stumps, driven firmly to mid on.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to bowl.
Fuller on off, de Kock blocks it off the outer half towards cover.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks out to bat.

OUT! DUCK FOR BAVUMA! Pradeep is breathing fire at the moment with a double strike. It's the full outswinger outside off, Bavuma chases with zero footwork and gets a thick edge that flies high to third slip where Silva takes a very sharp catch. Bavuma's lean patch continues. This pitch has quickened up really well and one has to feel that the Lankans have woken up late with 364 already on the board. Nevertheless, a good comeback today from the tourists.
Good length closer to off, nips in with bounce, left alone to the keeper.
TEMBA BAVUMA is the new man in.

OUT! Faf's struggle is over! Length ball slanted in from around off, Faf is squared up once again due to the late movement and extra bounce. The edge flies to second slip where Mendis pouches the offering with glee. The SA skipper never looked comfortable and he has to depart now. It's been a very good morning for the Lankans so far, they've bowled really well and have also choked the runs.
Length ball outside off, stays back to block but gets a bottom edge on the bounced towards gully.
Peach! Full and closer to off, shaping away, Faf is squared up completely by the late movement.
Drinks are on the field!!!
Gets right behind the line and offers a solid defense.
Length ball outside off, moves away a shade, Hashim doesn't offer any stroke.
Gets a bit across and defends it back to the bowler.
HA chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Similar ball and Hashim once again makes a leave to Chandimal.
Shortish length delivery served on off, Amla decides to leave it alone.

FOUR! That's slapped! Pradeep bowls it a bit too short and gives width as well. du Plessis backs away and cuts it powerfully through covers to find the fence. Doesn't even bother running for that one. So, a boundary to start and end the over.
Easy leave made by the Protea skipper.
Shortish outside off, Faf makes an easy leave to the keeper.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish length and once again du Plessis rides the bounce and defends it.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Back of a length delivery outside off, Faf gets on top of the bounce and punches it through covers. Nicely done by the South African skipper.
Nuwan Pradeep is introduced into the attack!

OVERTHROWS! Oh dear, Amla would have been a goner as well. I will tell you why. Faf comes forward and pushes this full length delivery towards covers. They look for a single but there is a slight hesitation between the batsmen. Eventually they decide to cross. Lahiru Kumara has a shy at the striker's end and it misses. Replays show Amla would have been gone had that hit. To add to the woes, there wasn't any backup as the ball races away to the square leg fence. Five bonus runs added to the total.
Nipping away from off, this time du Plessis doesn't even look at it.
Faf du Plessis is down in some pain as he got hit on the body. The physio is out to assist him...

Ouch! Lamkal angles in a length ball from around off, it nips back in sharply as Faf looks to work it away on the leg side. Misses the line and is hit flush in the  stomach. He immediately throws his bat and is down in pain.
Gets right behind the line and offers a solid straight bat in defense.
Shortish outside off, Faf is happy to see it go through to the keeper.
On a length and angling in, with some sheer bounce, Faf is caught in his crease as he looks to defend but gets a bit of inside edge into the pads.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Amla defends it from within the crease.
Good length ball on off, tapped towards covers for a quick single.
In the corridor outside off, Faf allows it to go through the keeper.
Stays back and pushes it towards the off side.
Touch fuller and around off, pushed back to Mathews.
Shortish on middle, defended with a straight bat.
HA lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fuller and swinging away, Amla gets behind and drives it through covers for a brace.
Back of a length delivery outside off, the skipper gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
Outside off, Faf leaves it alone.

Edged and dropped!!! What have you done? Slip catches don't come that easy. Mendis has dropped a sitter and I am not even kidding. You gotta feel for Lakmal, he's asked to bowl long spells and almost delivers only to see himself getting unlucky. Back of a length ball outside off, moves away a bit with some bounce on it. du Plessis looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards second slip where Mendis leans forward to take it as the ball was dipping in front of him. He fails to cling on to that one as the chance goes down abegging.
Back of a length delivery outside off, du Plessis shoulders his arms to it.
Is off the mark straightaway! Good length ball on off, Faf prods forward and pushes it through covers for an easy single.
The Protea skipper, Faf du Plessis walks in next!

OUT! The decision is overturned! Really, really good review this from Sri Lanka. Mathews provides a breakthrough, the first breakthrough of the day. Angelo bowls a length ball outside off, Duanne Olivier looks to defend as the ball goes through to Chandimal. The Lankans put in an appeal but umpire Oxenford stays unmoved. The Asians feel there was a nick and so they take it upstairs. Replays show there was a feather and Olivier starts to walk back without troubling the scorers much.
An appeal for a caught behind against Duanne Olivier is referred upstairs. There was some noise, let's wait and see...
Fuller and outside off, driven through extra cover for a couple.
Touch short and outside off, tapped towards the off side by Dunnae. He wanted a single but Amla isn't interested.
Good shot! Fuller and around off, Hashim leans into it and drives it through mid off. Won't get a boundary but will pick up three runs.
On a length and asking Amla to play at it. He comes forward to defend but the ball straightens a touch and just beats the outside edge.
Good length ball outside off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Fuller in length and shapes away a touch, Olivier looks to drive it away from the body and misses it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on off, defended down on the off side.
Once again Suranga bowls in that probing zone outside off, Duanne tries to defend it away from the body and is beaten again due to the outward movement.
Hits the deck hard and moves away slightly, Olivier looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller and angling in, Amla comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, Hashim ignores.
Back of a length ball on middle, HA defends it with a straight bat.
Beaten! On a good length and just outside off, Amla looks to poke at it and is lucky not to edge one behind.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla doesn't fiddle with it.
Fuller in length and outside off, Hashim lifts his bat and lets it through.
Angles it on the pads, it's tucked behind square on the leg side for a single. Another good over from Lakmal.
HA lets the ball go outside his off stump.
This time it shapes away and Amla is happy to leave it safely.
Comes back in a long way! Length ball pitched around off, nipping back in sharply as Amla looks to work it away on the leg side but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Lakmal hurls a length ball from around off, it nips back in sharply to ping Amla on the pads. The ball rolls towards point and there is no appeal made for an LBW as the height was an issue there.
Fuller and angling in, Amla comes across to defend but gets a safe leading edge in the ground.
Fuller and coming back in, Duanne prods forward in defense.
Stays behind the line and defends it towards covers for a singe.

Olivier is off the mark! He gets his first run in Test cricket through an outside edge. On a length and angling in, the batsman gets squared up a bit and as a result gets an outside edge through backward point for a single.
Length ball outside off, tempting the batsman but DO drops his wrists to let it go.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, Olivier blocks it out.
Back of a length ball on off, Amla stays back and defends it towards the man at gully.
Nicely bowled! On a length and around off, Amla looks to defend it but the ball curls away and just beats the outside edge before going into the gloves of the keeper.
Fuller and angling in, Amla defends it off the front foot.
Harmless delivery outside off, it's  left alone.
Good length ball outside off, Hashim shoulders his arms to it. Doesn't want to fiddle with it early in the morning.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the back foot towards covers.
Stays behind the line and offers a solid defense back to the Lankan skipper.
Beats again! Good length delivery on off, straightens a bit after pitching, the debutant looks to defend but once again fails to put bat on ball.
Beaten! On a length and just around off, DO comes forward to defend but the ball moves away and just whizzes past the outside edge to Chandimal.
Length ball, moves away after pitching, Olivier doesn't even look at it.
Slightly fuller and outside off, defended gently off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller in length and outside off, Olivier comes forward, lifts his bat to let it go through.
Angelo Mathews to bowl from the other end!
On a length and nips back in a shade, Amla trusts the bounce and allows it to go through once more. A maiden to start the day.
Fuller and shaping away, Amla makes another easy leave to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, HA has got nothing to do with that one.
Angles in a length delivery on middle, Amla looks to defend but gets a leading edge as the ball rolls towards the off side.
On a length and just outside off, little bit of away movement there, Hashim is happy to let it be.
Starts with a full length delivery, moves away nicely, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Hashim Amla and Duanne Olivier will continue from where they left off. Sri Lanka begin with Suranga Lakmal. Here we go!!!

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the second day's play. South Africa are well and truly on top after a clinical first day performance. Duminy's fluent ton led the charge before the landmark man Amla in his 100th Test racked up a century of his own to return to form. He made the most of the dropped chance to hurt the Lankans. He's still there and eyeing a bigger milestone. Unless SL strike early this morning, they could be facing a really massive score. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 1.....

Nothing much to write about the Lankan bowling. They were quite good in the first session, particularly after drinks but lost the plot after lunch. They couldn't exploit the movement from the surface and couldn't keep the runs down either. With such a solid platform, South Africa will be eyeing a total in excess of 550 at least. Sri Lanka will hope to take a few early wickets tomorrow with the second new ball that's still relatively fresh to limit the damage. Join us at 1330 IST for the second day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Dominating day for South Africa after opting to bat on a lively surface. The SA openers departed cheaply and it could have gotten worse had Amla's catch been taken before lunch. But it wasn't and he made them pay with an unbeaten ton in his 100th Test. Duminy produced a fluent ton of his own and was the aggressor for a major part of the day before his partner caught up towards the end. The southpaw departed just before stumps to a lazy shot but by then, he had given his side the day's honors.
Spears in a full ball on off, Olivier gets behind the line and defends it to the off side. STUMPS ON DAY 1!
What a delivery! Extra zip from the surface, full and around off and shooting off the surface, Olivier tries to defend from the crease but is beaten.
Extra bounce around off, Amla jumps a bit on his back foot and nudges it to deep backward square leg for a run.
On a length and just outside off, nipping back in a bit, Amla allows it through.
Bowls it wide outside off, Amla once again makes a watchful leave.
Good length delivery outside off, shaping away, Amla shoulders arms.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Bouncer to greet the new batsman, Olivier ducks underneath it.
Debutant Duanne Olivier is the nightwatchman.

OUT! Duminy departs at the fag end of the day! Kumara strikes and is pumped up. He angles across a length delivery outside off, JP gets forward to push inside the line and nicks it behind to second slip. Kusal Mendis dives to his left to complete a good catch. End of a brilliant innings and JP walks back amidst a huge cheer from the crowd. This also brings an end to an extraordinary 292-run stand.
On a good length around off, Duminy defends it off his back foot.
Digs in a short ball around leg, Duminy is hurried up and fends it off gloves to fine leg for a couple of runs.

FOUR! 2nd score of 150-plus for Duminy in Tests! Great batting by the southpaw. This time he plays an extremely late cut to find the gap and the third man fence. Amla hugs him and quietly shares some words. This has been an outstanding knock by JP. A chanceless one!
Lahiru Kumara to bowl the penultimate over of the day.
In the zone outside off, holding its line, Hashim leaves it alone.
Serves it on a driving length outside off, Amla gets across the stumps and allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and around off, Amla gets on the front foot and defends.
Too wide outside off, Amla leaves it alone this time.
FOUR! Tired bowling, poor bowling, call whatever you want to. Bowling it short and wide outside off, Amla flashes and flashes hard to send it down to the third man fence.
On a length and around off, Amla defends it from within the crease.
Nuwan Pradeep replaces Mathews in the attack.
Short and wide outside off, Duminy rocks back and steers it through backward point for a couple of runs.
On a length and around off, Duminy remains back and defends it to the off side.
Full in length and around middle and leg, nipping in, Amla fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length and around off, shaping away, Amla shoulders arms.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Advances down the track and pushes it wide of short extra cover for a single. The mid off fielder gets across to stop the ball and has a wayward throw at the non-striker's end. An overthrow taken as well.
Mathews comes from around the wicket and angles in a full length ball. It keeps on going with the angle and Duminy decides to leave it. Almost shaves past his back pad to the keeper.
Pitches it full and outside off, Amla nudges it to covers and crosses for a brisk single.
Angles it in, fullish around off, Amla strides forward and defends it to covers.
Full and arrowing into the batsman, Hashim gets on the front foot and defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball angling away from the batsman, JP allows it through to the keeper.
Beauty! Slightly short and around off, moving back into the batsman, Duminy tries to defend from the crease but it nips back in to beat the inside edge of his bat and cuts him into half.

Shaping back into the batsman with extra bounce, Amla gets surprised by it and does well to play it off a loose bottom hand. The ball goes off the inside edge to long leg and they cross over for a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Amla gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off, moving back in this time, Duminy tries to play straight but it catches the inside half of the bat and rolls wide of mid on for a single.
Beaten! Lands it on a fuller length outside off, nipping away, Duminy has a tame push inside the line and misses.
Fullish and in the zone outside off, holding its line, Amla has nothing to do with it.
Straighter in line, Duminy gets across the stumps and works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish and around off, Duminy takes his front foot forward to cover the line and leaves it.
Fullish and around off, Duminy gets forward and pushes it off his pads to mid on.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Welcome back for the final session. Sri Lanka seeking redemption, South Africa eyeing further dominance. The second new ball might be a semblance of hope for the tourists but they will need to bowl well. Duminy and Amla looking extremely ominous at the moment. RANGANA HERATH to bowl first up after tea.
.....DAY 1, SESSION 3.....

South Africa's session comfortably. Duminy and Amla batted on with confidence, almost chanceless after lunch to drive the hosts forward. The southpaw is nearing his ton while Amla after a struggle, has been flowing smoothly in his 100th Test to go past fifty. Sri Lanka's bowlers have looked disinterested in this session and have allowed far too many easy runs. That dropped catch of Amla before lunch will continue to haunt SL. The tourists will hope for some change in fortunes after tea. Join us in a while for the final session.

Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled in from outside off, JP lifts his bat to let it through.
Length ball slanting in from outside off, keeps low as JP lets it pass.
Good length angled in from outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends well.
This has been a very positive and busy partnership.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Oozing class. Full ball outside off, Duminy leans into it and thumps it through the covers on the up. Nobody really budged as it raced away to the fence. Sublime stuff.
Full on middle, Amla plays across the line but gets a leading edge towards point.
Good length outside off, dabbed to point for a single.
Beaten! Fuller outside off, Duminy drives loosely at it but the ball flies past the outside edge.
Back of a length outside off, lets it pass to the keeper.
Dug in short around leg stump, no shot offered to that one. Mathews has overstepped and it's a no ball. Brings up the 50-run stand. Solid and steady stuff.
FOUR! Creamed! Full ball outside off, classy cover drive from Duminy on the up. Timed it sweetly and it zinged across the turf to the ropes in no time.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped past mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length on off, JP gets it off the inside half of the blade down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Streaky runs for Duminy! Full ball outside off, he drives lazily at it and gets the slice that flies behind point for a boundary. Wasn't in control there and got lucky not to find the fielder.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Good length just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, another scorching straight drive towards extra cover.
Good length on off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Another lovely outswinger outside off, left alone to the keeper. Mathews would be better off getting the ball a bit closer to the off pole.
Full and well outside off, shapes further away. Easy leave for Amla due to the line.
Fullish and just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and around off, leans into it and defends it solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks it well to the bowler.
Good length closer to off stump, left alone to the keeper.
Good length around off, gets across to that one and defends solidly down the pitch.
FOUR! SHOT! His drives in the V have been brilliant in the last two months. Full ball outside off, Duminy leans forward and drives it elegantly past mid off to find the fence. Beautiful stroke.
On a length outside off, angling away, easy leave for JP.
Good length outside off, slanting away as JP lets it pass.
Fuller ball wider outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Streaky moment! Fuller ball just outside off, nips in a bit as Amla looks to block. Goes off the bottom half and rolls past the stumps towards the keeper.
Off the edge! Another gentle full outswinger outside off, Amla pushes at it with soft hands as the outside edge doesn't carry to gully.
Full and outside off, shaping away late as Amla lets it pass.
Another full ball, honing in around middle, Amla shuffles across and blocks.
Fuller on off, Amla gets on the front foot and defends solidly.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.

Welcome back for the second session. Sri Lanka will hope that their seamers get their accuracy further up and will also want their fielders to take catches. They cannot afford South Africa to run away on a pitch like this. The hosts will want one partnership, preferably the current one to set the tone. ANGELO MATHEWS to begin proceedings after lunch.
.....DAY 1, SESSION 2.....

Even session of Test cricket after du Plessis opted to bat. The first hour was a very attritional phase with the SA openers seeing it off albeit with some luck. After drinks, Mathews removed Cook and then Kumara removed Elgar to trigger a comeback for the visitors. Since then, Duminy has batted fluently along with a very edgy Amla who was lucky to be dropped just before the break. SL will hope that it doesn't cost them much. All the Lankan pacers were fairly probing on a pitch that has aided the quicker men. Join us in a while for the second session.

Four byes! Shocker of a ball to end the session. Sprays it way down the leg side, Duminy cannot reach the ball and the diving keeper cannot get to it either as the ball races to the fence. LUNCH ON DAY 1.
More fortune for Amla. Fuller on middle, Amla gets a thick inside edge that goes through his legs towards the on side as the batsmen take a single.
Good length outside off, another leave from Amla.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.

DROPPED! You cannot drop catches like that and you certainly cannot drop players of Amla's caliber like that. Length ball outside off, it's one of Amla's recent trademark pokes away from the body. Gets the edge that flies low to gully where de Silva fluffs the chance. What a wicket this would have been for the Lankans! Could have given them the boost going to lunch but not to be. Might just be the luck Amla needed. He's been dismissed quite a lot in the last six months in such a fashion.
Back of a length well wide outside off, left alone to the keeper.

In the air, in the gap! Fuller on middle, Amla shuffles to work it on the leg side but doesn't keep the stroke down. Luckily for him it goes right between mid-wicket and mid on as it goes to the deep. Three runs to the total.
Back of a length on off, hangs on the back foot and defends well.
Full and outside off, Duminy gets forward and taps it towards short cover for a brisk single. This pair has already pinched some quick singles and Sri Lanka must start blocking these runs.
Pitched up on fourth stump line, good leave from Duminy.
Fuller ball around off, JP presses forward and defends.
Good length closer to off, blocked firmly off the front foot.
NUWAN PRADEEP comes back on.
Good length outside off, a bit wide and an easy leave for Amla.
Fuller on the stumps, Duminy gets across to that one and bunts it firmly past the bowler down the ground towards long on. Three more taken.
Switches to around the wicket.
FOUR! GLORIOUS SHOT! Overpitched and Duminy caresses the drive straight past the bowler down the ground to the ropes. Delicious stroke from JP who has begun really well in this innings.
Fuller around leg stump, inswing but the line isn't right as it goes down the leg side. Duminy misses the flick.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.

FOUR! Good length angled across Duminy who glides it with an open face. Played it with soft hands and gets it past a diving gully fielder towards third man. Kumara gave a long chase and hurt his wrists slightly while trying to stop the ball. A boundary to the southpaw.
SURANGA LAKMAL comes back on.
Fuller ball outside off, tapped gently to cover for a single to keep strike.
Length ball wider outside off, easy leave for Duminy.
Full on middle, gets forward and blocks it to short extra cover.
Good length angled in from around off, extra bounce as Amla fends awkwardly to the leg side. Gets a rap on the glove.
Good length around off, blocked well from the crease.
Fuller around off, JP presses forward and taps it gently to the off side. Quick single taken.
Fuller outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Good length closer to off, tapped gently towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Banged halfway down the track, sits up nicely for Duminy who goes for the pull. Not middled well but still gets it to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, JP drives fluently but straight to extra cover.
Dug in short on off, Duminy goes for the pull stroke but doesn't connect.
Fuller outside off, Duminy gets on the front foot and blocks.
Length ball angled away wider outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, defended well off the front foot to cover.
Lovely ball! Good length angled in from outside off, draws Amla into a half-hearted poke but the ball jags away late to beat the outside edge.
Good length outside off, nice shape for Mathews but the line is too wide to make Amla interested.
Good length outside off, Amla gets forward and blocks solidly.
Length ball outside off, stays back and blocks.
Shortish outside off, JP doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Back of a length outside off, a bit too wide to make the batsman play.
Full and on off, driven off the front foot towards mid on.
Close shave for Duminy! He misses the full inswinger and is struck on the pads. Did too much off the deck.
Dug in short from around off, JP sways away from the line.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it well to cover for a single.
Fuller around off, nips in a bit as JP gets an inside edge on to the pads. That almost sneaked through.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

FOUR! Delicately done! Fuller ball on the pads, Duminy gets across a bit and glances it deftly down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. That was a gift and JP wasn't going to miss out on it. 50 up for SA.

How close was that? Good length on middle, Amla shuffles a bit too much but misses the flick to be rapped on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. Huge lbw appeal but it's turned down. Perhaps a very marginal call, clipping leg probably. A leg bye taken.
Fuller around off, defended well off the front foot.

Edged but falls safe! Good partnership bowling from the Lankans. Good length angled in from around off, straightens with extra bounce as Amla is squared up. The edge dies in front of first slip as the second slip fielder dives to his right to reach it.
Good length slanting across Duminy who lets it pass.
Beaten! Nervy stuff from Duminy. Back of a length outside off, steep bounce for Kumara once again and Duminy is lucky not to get the edge.
Good length around off, Duminy stays back and defends well.
Fuller on the stumps, patted back to the bowler.
JP Duminy is the new man in.

OUT! KUMARA STRIKES! One wicket often brings two and the Lankans are absolutely pumped up. Back of a length outside off, extra bounce as Elgar pushes at it. Gets the outside edge that flies straight to Karunaratne at first slip. All of a sudden, all that hard work of seeing off the first hour is undone for the Proteas as both openers are back in the hut. Sri Lanka have roared back after the drinks break.
Full and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Off the edge but safe! Full outside off, shaping away as Amla pushes at it. The outside edge results but it's well short of the slip cordon. Good probing over from the Lankan skipper.
Length ball closer to off, Amla gets behind the line and blocks it well.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
HASHIM AMLA is the new man in. The 100th Test for him and let's see whether he rises to the occasion.

OUT! GONE! Mathews draws first blood. Full inswinger from around off, tails into ping Cook on the front pad as he plays across the line. Huge appeal for lbw and it's given almost instantly by the umpire. Cook goes for the review after a chat with Elgar. Not sure why though as it looked close. They check for the no ball initially and it's really close but Mathews is just fine. Over to the ball then, impact in line and crashing middle and leg. That's the early breakthrough for the Lankans.
Cook has been given out lbw. He opts for the review. Looked quite plumb to the naked eye.
Once again full on middle, Cook clips it to the leg side.
Fuller on middle, worked on the leg side.
Bonus runs! Kumara fires it way down the leg side, Elgar misses and it even a diving Chandimal cannot reach it. The ball speeds to the fence for FOUR LEG BYES.
Too straight from Kumara and Cook works it on the leg side for a single.
That took off! Shortish outside off, Elgar stays back and jabs it to the off side. The ball flew off his glove. Single taken.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and blocks it to the off side.
Short on middle, Elgar swivels and pulls it away through square leg for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Elgar jams it with an open face towards gully on the bounce.
LAHIRU KUMARA comes on to bowl.
Shortish outside off, shapes away late as Cook lets it pass to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and jabs it towards point for a single.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller on off, gets across and defends it around the front pad.
Full and outside off, Elgar looks to block and gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Edged but doesn't carry! Back of a length outside off, Elgar pushes at it with soft hands and the outside edge just falls short of Silva at third slip.

Drinks break. First hour successfully negotiated by the South African openers. There were some nervous moments but Elgar and Cook have done well to survive. Sri Lanka started superbly, bowled great lines but failed to keep consistency. 21 runs in the last 3 overs and they need to apply more pressure with the fairly new ball. Cannot let the chips down so early in a Test match.
Full in length and outside off, curving away, Cook watches the line closely and allows it through.
Guided down to fine leg by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Elgar defends it off his back foot.

Dropped by Chandimal? Slightly short in length and going down the leg side, Elgar tries to glance but misses and it goes off his hips to the keeper. Chandimal dives to his right but it's way wide of him. He only manages a glove on it and the ball deflects behind for FOUR BYES at fine leg.
On a length and outside off, shaping back in a bit, Elgar gets back to cover the line and shoulders arms.
Angles in a full length ball on off, Cook goes on this back foot and works it on the leg side. It rolls behind square leg for a single.
In the zone outside off, a gentle fuller length ball, left alone by Elgar.
Fullish and around off, angling away, Elgar covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Angles across a full length ball outside off, Elgar allows it through to the keeper.
Full and around off, Elgar gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shot! Welcome into the attack, skipper! A gentle loosener by Mathews, 114.6 kph, bowls it full and around off, Elgar gets on the front foot and drives it crisply through mid off for a boundary.
Bowling change. Angelo Mathews brings himself into the attack.

Once again the umpires are checking the shape of the ball. This time they have decided to get it changed. It appears there is no 11-over old ball available. Umpire Rod Tucker is doing his best in making it look like one by bouncing it multiple times on the pitch. Interesting. Haven't seen this technique used before.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Lakmal loses his radar, sprays a length ball down the leg side, Elgar nudges it to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Two in a row! Shorter and slightly wider outside off, Elgar eases himself on the back foot and punches it past the right side of the point fielder for a boundary. Easy pickings for a batsman in prime form.
Some issue with the ball. The umpires get together to have a look but it's going easily through the hoop. No change needed.
FOUR! Fine shot! An overpitched ball around off, Dean gets on the front foot and caresses it back past his partner at the other end for a boundary. First of the innings.
Back of a length ball angling away from the batsman, Elgar goes back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.
Good length ball on off, Elgar gets behind the line and defends it off the inner half of the bat to the leg side.
Goes very full with his length this time, outside off, Cook gets forward and plays it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Gentle delivery this time, outside off and moving away, Cook shoulders arms.
Brings a full length ball on off, Cook gets behind the line and presents a straight bat in defense.
Full and outside off, Cook once again decides to leave it but this time he is late in taking his bat away. It goes off the bottom edge to gully.
Throws it full and wide outside off, the away movement takes the ball further away from the batsman, Cook has nothing to do with it.
Full and outside off, shaping away, Cook has an easy leave.
Extra bounce, on a good length around leg, Elgar tries flicking but misses and it goes off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Serves a length ball in the line of the stumps, Elgar comes behind the line and defends it to the leg side.
Another nervous push and miss outside off by Elgar. Beautiful bowling by Lakmal.
Once again there was a near outside edge. Lakmal angles across a good length ball around off, shaping away, Elgar initially looks to play at it but then withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Almost an outside edge! Back of a length delivery on off, nipping away, Elgar remains back, has a lazy push inside the line and misses.
Slightly short in length on middle, jumping onto the batsman, Elgar gets on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Gets forward and pushes it towards the cover region for a quick single.
Goes further up with his length, lands it very full and gets it to nip back in, Cook inside edges his flick to long leg for a run.
Lands it full and outside off, shaping away, an easy leave for Stephen.
Bouncer but it's directionless. Down the leg side and Cook sways away from the line of fire.
Good length delivery outside off, seaming away, Cook allows it  through to the keeper.
Fuller and straighter, Cook eases it off his pads past short leg and collects a couple of runs.
Full and outside off, angling away, it's left alone by Dean.
Way wide outside off this time, Elgar has a comfortable leave.
Inviting length this, outside off, there to be driven, Elgar has decided not to play at it.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

Appeal for a catch! Lakmal bowls it on a good length around off and gets it to move back sharply into the batsman, Elgar tries defending it from the crease but it beats the inside edge and brushes the flap of the back pad. There is an appeal for a catch but the umpire shakes his head. Mathews thinks and thinks about reviewing it but he doesn't have all the day to do it. Timed out eventually. He never was convinced though. Good call, the replays confirm the source of the sound to be the flap of the back pad. No inside edge.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Nearly edges it! Superb delivery by Pradeep, keeps it full and outside off, inviting the drive from the batsman, Cook tries doing it but it curls away to beat the outside edge. Terrific over.
Full and on off, angling in, Cook gets forward a bit and pushes it to covers.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Appeal for an lbw! Pradeep gets a full length ball to nip back into the batsman from around off, Cook fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Mathews decides not to take the DRS and the replays show it to be going over leg. Good call!
Pitches it full and outside off, shaping away, Cook gets forward to cover the line and shoulders arms.
Just a touch short in length and outside off, Cook tries to run it down maybe but it comes off the bottom edge and rests near the pitch.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
A little too wide outside off to bother the batsman. Elgar is content in leaving it for the keeper.
Puts it on a fuller length outside off, Elgar plays a controlled push through the line and finds Mathews at extra cover.
Good length delivery wide outside off, another leave by Dean.
Another full ball, just around off and zipping through the surface, Elgar leaves it alone.
Fuller in length and outside off, Elgar gets forward and gently pushes it through covers. Mathews chases it from extra cover and they take a couple of runs.
Fullish and outside off, Elgar gets forward and pushes it through covers. Herath gives it the chase and puts in a slide near the fence to pull it back. A run saved by the old man.
Drops it on a length and outside off, shaping away again, Elgar leaves it alone.

Edged but safe! Pradeep gets a good length ball to shape away, Elgar has a tentative push inside the line, no footwork whatsoever and nicks it behind. It falls in front of Kaushal Silva at third slip.
Well bowled, lands it full and around middle, Elgar presses forward and defends it with an angled bat to the off side. There is movement on offer and the Sri Lankan bowlers have bowled good lines.
Wide outside off, on a good length, Elgar allows it through.

Serves it full and around off, shaping away a shade, Cook with limited footwork tries to push it through covers but ends up slicing it off the outside half of the bat. It speeds through point and the fielder stationed there makes a partial stop. One run added to the total.
Angles across a length ball, just around off, Elgar watches the line closely and shoulders arms. Another decent over.
Full in length and on off, Cook gets half forward and works it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. A single taken.
Fullish and on off, angling in, Cook moves across a bit flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Brilliant delivery, nipping back in sharply off a length outside off, Cook fails to defend it, there is some steep bounce and it hits the batsman on the thigh pad.
Straighter in line, Elgar tucks it through mid-wicket and collects a single. Off the mark.
Pitches it full and around off, Elgar lunges and pushes it towards mid off.
Fullish and on off, Cook gets behind the line, is squared up a bit but does well to keep it out with an angled bat. Fab start from the Sri Lankan pacers!
Sharp delivery, outside off and once again zipping away off the surface, Cook allows it through.
Absolute beauty by Pradeep. Serves it on a full length around off and it zips off the surface with good away movement, Cook tries his best to put bat on ball but is beaten.
Hurls it on a fuller length and wide outside off again, another leave by Stephen.
On a length and wide outside off, shaping away, an easy leave for Cook this time.
Good start, right on the mark, full and around off, moving away, Cook gets a bit forward and pushes it to covers.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl from the other end.

South Africa are away! Too full in length and around off, not allowing the ball to swing much, Cook gets forward and pushes it down the ground through mid on. They take three runs and Cook is off the mark. Tremendous first over by Lakmal.
Peach of a delivery! Lakmal gets a full ball to angle into the batsman, around off, Cook tries to cover the line and defend but it curls away off the seam to beat the outside edge.
Back of a length delivery landing outside off, Cook once again decides to leave it alone but it jags back in and strikes him on the thigh pad.
Beauty of a delivery. Lakmal lets out an inswinger this time, landing outside off and seaming back in, Cook once again covers the line before leaving it. Good carry to the keeper.
Drops it on a full length and just around off, shaping away off the seam, Cook covers the line and shoulders arms.
Starts with a very full ball on middle and off, angling in, Cook works it on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.

National anthems are done and dusted. The players are now taking the field. It's Dean Elgar and Stephen Cook to open the batting for the Proteas. The conditions are expected to be testing first up in the morning and Sri Lanka would like to exploit it in their favour. Suranga Lakmal to start proceedings. Three slips, a gully and a short leg in place. Here we go...

TEAM NEWS - Sri Lanka are playing with the same XI while the Proteas have made two changes. DUANNE OLIVIER makes his debut while WAYNE PARNELL also comes back. Kyle Abbott and Keshav Maharaj sit out for the hosts.
SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the final Test in Johannesburg. It's been a dark last week for the hosts with the Kolpak deal gaining prominence. While the off-field issues have been there, the Proteas have stamped their authority in this series completely. The Lankans, short on experience and possibly skills, have struggled to compete barring the odd passage of play. Let's see if the visitors have any gas in the tank. Another lively surface beckons here at the Wanderers. The toss is coming up shortly.
